parameters.content:
## Send approved emails
Only rows with Stage = Drafted and Approved = Yes, max 15 per run (inbox warm-up). Skips anything opted out, blocked, or on the Suppression tab (İYS opt-outs). Sends plain text from the Workspace inbox, logs the email in HubSpot, then writes Stage = Sent, thread ID and follow-up date back to the sheet. 90 s pause between sends. Every send, skip and quota pause is appended to the Log tab.

TEST MODE: if Settings has a non-empty "Test Email", every email (and the HubSpot contact) goes to that address instead of the lead. Clear it before real sending.

## HubSpot quota gate
Estimates this month's HubSpot actions from the Leads tab (first email 2, follow-up 1, reply 2). At HubSpot Pause Percent (Settings, default 80%) of HubSpot Monthly Limit (default 3,000) it stops sending first emails and emails Nil. Follow-ups (WF5) and replies (WF4) keep running.
